headline: US Lawmakers Issue Statement on Administration's Intent to Remove South Africa from AGOA
summary: U.S. lawmakers released a statement addressing the administration's intention to terminate South Africa from the African Growth and Opportunity Act trade program.
why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act provides duty-free access to the US market for eligible sub-Saharan African nations, impacting regional export competitiveness.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Removal from a preferential trade agreement can impair export volumes and trade balance for the affected country.
